global_flags.summary: Execute an approved reverse-ETL plan by id.

global_flags.name: confirm
global_flags.summary: Typed confirmation challenge for destructive reverse-ETL writes.

help_topics.name: bahmni-docker-auth
help_topics.summary: Point base_url at a local bahmni-docker OpenMRS instance and supply username/password via credentials; never pass secrets in command text.

help_topics.name: bahmni-docker-writes
help_topics.summary: Bahmni clinical mutations are typed reverse-ETL actions with plan, preview, approval, execute gates; clinical/destructive actions require --confirm destructive.

help_topics.name: bahmni-docker-direct-read
help_topics.summary: Bahmni direct reads are bounded JSON GET-by-uuid, FHIR read-by-id, or a schema-gated typed POST patient search, all with PHI redaction and a response byte cap.

help_topics.name: bahmni-docker-phi
help_topics.summary: Bahmni handles clinical PHI: patient identifiers, names, addresses, and clinical values are redacted by default on patient-linked reads and in write plans.
